text:
kai: Quick rollup of the hetero GPTQ lift tests across families — I ran a focused sweep (GPTQ-4 + mixed AWQ checks) on Llama2-7B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-7B and Qwen-14B. Short summary below, full numbers attached inline.

anika: Nice. high-level take?

kai: TL;DR: GPTQ-4 gives best memory/throughput tradeoff across the board but Qwen-14B shows larger accuracy variance. AWQ hybrids helped Mistral be closer to FP16 baseline on some instruction tasks.

mike: Can you drop the exact deltas? want to decide canary thresholds.

kai: Sure — averaged over our instruction+factual eval set (approx 8k prompts):
- Llama2-7B GPTQ-4: EM -1.8%, F1 -1.2% vs FP16
- Mistral-7B GPTQ-4: EM -0.4%, F1 -0.3%
- Qwen-7B GPTQ-4: EM -2.1%, F1 -1.6%
- Qwen-14B GPTQ-4: EM -3.2%, F1 -2.7%

sara: Qwen-14B is the outlier. where does AWQ help?

kai: AWQ-mixed (outlier blocks kept higher precision) reduced Qwen-14B EM drop to -1.4% but increased model size vs pure GPTQ-4 by ~8%.

luis: Perf numbers? latency / memory / throughput

kai: On our C5-ish GPU profile (A100 80GB equiv):
- GPTQ-4: 1.6x throughput vs FP16, memory footprint -42%, p95 latency +8ms
- AWQ-hybrid: 1.35x throughput, memory -35%, p95 latency +5ms
- INT8 fp8 experiments were unstable for Llama at seq=2048 — KV-cache divergence observed.

qa-bot: Regression check: no new catastrophic failures, but 38 prompt-level regressions flagged (>=10% drop) on Qwen-14B GPTQ-4, mostly math/long-context.

mike: Any idea root cause for Qwen-14B math/long-context issues?

kai: Suspect group-size and layernorm folding interaction. When grouping at 128 we saw much worse KV error accumulation for Qwen-14B long context. Group-size=64 improves accuracy but costs 6% throughput.

sara: Did you try per-channel scale vs global scale quantization variants?

kai: Yep — PCQ (per-channel) helped a bit on numeric tasks for Qwen family. For Mistral difference negligible. Llama benefits from PCQ on small heads.

luis: Any config snippets for repro / quant command?

kai: Pasted quick command we used:
```
python tools/gptq/quantize.py \
  --model checkpoints/qwen-14b \
  --bits 4 \
  --group-size 64 \
  --per-channel True \
  --calib-file data/calib/8k.jsonl \
  --out-dir builds/qwen-14b-gptq4-gs64
```

anika: Good. For deployment, what's the suggested rollout per-family?

kai: Proposed rollout plan:
- Mistral-7B GPTQ-4: canary 10% traffic x24h, monitor EM/F1 and p99 latency — safe to 100% if <0.5% EM delta.
- Llama2-7B GPTQ-4: canary 7% x24h, expand if no regression >1.0%.
- Qwen-7B GPTQ-4: canary 5% x48h, watch long-context eval slices.
- Qwen-14B: do AWQ-hybrid canary 3% x72h, require per-prompt regression gating; otherwise hold.

qa-bot: Alert hooks recommended: evaluation suite run at 1h cadence for canary, block rollout if any prompt-level regression >10% or global EM drop >1.5% on the canary slice.

mike: For Dedicated customers wanting lower latency, any recommendations re: group-size vs latency?

kai: If latency SLO tight, group-size 128 yields slightly better throughput but watch Qwen family at long context — use model-specific group-size: Llama ->128, Mistral ->128, Qwen->64.

luis: Anything surprising in logs / artifacts?

kai: One oddity — tokenizer alignment differences caused a few false regressions for Mistral on one eval subset; after normalizing tokenization those went away. Also saw a rare NaN in fused attention kernel on one build (repro'd once) — filed infra ticket #INF-321.

anika: Next steps?

kai: I'll push the AWQ-hybrid builds for Qwen-14B to staging, add per-prompt gating to canary pipeline, and kick off the 72h canary if staging checks pass. I'll also add a short eval doc summarizing per-slice diffs and the config blobs.

sara: Thanks — ping here when staging builds ready.

luis: add me to the canary watchlist.

qa-bot: Noted: created canary-watchlist with participants [mike, luis, sara].

kai: Will post artifacts + a short CSV with per-prompt deltas when ready. End of quick rollup.
